'''Purificación López-García''' is a Spanish-born French [[biologist]] and research director of [[Paris-Saclay University]] who studies the [[history of life]].<ref>{{cite news
 |last=Sánchez
 |first=Carlos Manuel
 |title=Purificación López-García: «Las bacterias nos sobrevivirán. Seamos humildes»
 |url=https://www.elcorreo.com/xlsemanal/personajes/purificacion-lopez-garcia-biologa-busca-origen-vida.html
 |work=XL Semanal
 |date=18 November 2022
 |language=es
 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260417203508/https://www.elcorreo.com/xlsemanal/personajes/purificacion-lopez-garcia-biologa-busca-origen-vida.html
 |archive-date=17 April 2026
}}</ref>

== Early life ==
Born in Madrid in September 23, 1965, Purificación "Puri" López García studied biology at [[Complutense University of Madrid]] and marine biology at the [[University of La Laguna]], before undertaking a thesis in the [[Autonomous University of Madrid]] on the genomic organisation of the [[Haloarchaea|halophilic archaeon]] ''[[Haloferax mediterranei]]'', which she defended in 1992. She began her postdoctoral research at [[Paris-Sud University]], [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] and [[Miguel Hernández University of Elche]]. She then became assistant professor at the [[University of Alicante]] in 2001.<ref>{{cite web
 |last=Boutaud
 |first=Anne-Sophie
 |title=Purification López-García : plongée aux extrêmes limites du vivant
 |url=https://www.science-et-vie.com/nature-et-environnement/purificacion-lopez-garcia-plongee-aux-extremes-limites-du-vivant-70006.html
 |website=Science & Vie
 |date=9 May 2021
 |language=fr
}}</ref>

In 2002 López-García joined [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|CNRS]] (French National Centre for Science) as a researcher. Since 2007 she has been a research director<ref>{{cite news
 |last=Goubet
 |first=Fabien
 |title=L'archée Loki, vieille cousine venue du fond des mers
 |url=https://www.letemps.ch/sciences/larchee-loki-vieille-cousine-venue-fond-mers
 |work=Le Temps
 |date=7 May 2015
 |language=fr
}}</ref> of the CNRS within the Systematic Ecology and Evolution unit at the [[Paris-Saclay University]].<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Purificación López García, una naturalista del mundo microbiano
 |url=https://www.rfi.fr/es/programas/mundo-ciencia/20250113-purificaci%C3%B3n-l%C3%B3pez-garc%C3%ADa-una-naturalista-del-mundo-microbiano-academie-des-sciences
 |website=Radio France Internationale
 |language=es
 |date=13 January 2025
}}</ref> She is interested in studying the diversity of life and [[abiogenesis]].<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Where do we come from? A 4-billion-year journey to the origin of our cells
 |url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/en/where-do-we-come-4-billion-year-journey-origin-our-cells-article-purificacion-lopez-garcia
 |website=Académie des sciences
 |date=7 January 2026
 |language=en
}}</ref>  As part of the "DEEM" team of scientists she has studied ecological diversity, and the evolution of [[Prokaryote|prokaryotic]]  and [[Eukaryote|eukaryotic]] [[microorganisms]].<ref>{{cite web
 |last=Wilcox
 |first=Christie
 |title=Did Viruses Create the Nucleus? The Answer May Be Near
 |url=https://www.quantamagazine.org/did-viruses-create-the-nucleus-the-answer-may-be-near-20201125/
 |website=Quanta Magazine
 |date=25 November 2020
 |language=en
}}</ref>

== Research ==
Puri López-García's main research interest is the evolution of life through approaches in microbial ecology and molecular [[Phylogenetics|phylogeny]]. She has contributed to expanding the known diversity of microorganisms in three domains of life (archaea, bacteria, eukaryotes) and to better understand their ecology and evolution.

Her team's work combines classical ([[Microbiological culture|culture]], [[microscopy]]) and molecular ([[metabarcoding]], [[metagenomics]], [[phylogenomics]]) approaches in order to research microbial communities in understudied ecosystems, including [[extreme environments]].<ref>{{cite web
 |last=Gorman
 |first=James
 |title=In the Search for Aliens, Look for the Weirdest Life on Earth
 |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/01/science/extreme-life-aliens.html
 |website=The New York Times
 |date=November 1, 2019
 |access-date=April 17, 2026
}}</ref> She holds interdisciplinary collaborations with scientists interested in the abiogenesis, [[extremophile]]s, and microorganism-mineral interactions.<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Presentation by Dr. Purificación López-García: Modern microbialites as analogs of fossil stromatolites
 |url=https://www.uib.no/en/geobio/61039/presentation-dr-purificaci%C3%B3n-l%C3%B3pez-garc%C3%ADa-modern-microbialites-analogs-fossil
 |website=Centre for Geobiology, University of Bergen
 |date=14 January 2013
 |language=en
}}</ref> In 1998, along with David Moreira, she proposed the "[[syntrophy#Syntrophic theories of eukaryogenesis|syntrophy hypothesis]]" for [[eukaryogenesis]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Moreira |first=David |last2=López-García |first2=Purificación |date=1998-11-01 |title=Symbiosis Between Methanogenic Archaea and δ-Proteobacteria as the Origin of Eukaryotes: The Syntrophic Hypothesis |url=https://doi.org/10.1007/PL00006408 |journal=Journal of Molecular Evolution |volume=47 |issue=5 |pages=517–530 |doi=10.1007/PL00006408 |issn=1432-1432|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=López-García |first=Purificación |last2=Moreira |first2=David |date=2020-04-27 |title=The Syntrophy hypothesis for the origin of eukaryotes revisited |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/s41564-020-0710-4 |journal=Nature Microbiology |language=en |volume=5 |issue=5 |pages=655–667 |doi=10.1038/s41564-020-0710-4 |issn=2058-5276}}</ref> Also with Moreira, she has objected to [[Patrick Forterre]]'s support of the [[virus world hypothesis]]<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Moreira |first=David |last2=López-García |first2=Purificación |date=April 2009 |title=Ten reasons to exclude viruses from the tree of life |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/nrmicro2108 |journal=Nature Reviews Microbiology |language=en |volume=7 |issue=4 |pages=306–311 |doi=10.1038/nrmicro2108 |issn=1740-1526|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Moreira |first=David |last2=López-García |first2=Purificación |date=2015-09-26 |title=Evolution of viruses and cells: do we need a fourth domain of life to explain the origin of eukaryotes? |url=http://royalsocietypublishing.org/rstb/article/30211 |journal=Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences |language=en |volume=370 |issue=1678 |pages=20140327 |doi=10.1098/rstb.2014.0327 |issn=0962-8436|pmc=4571566 }}</ref>
